Options to reduce cost

Savings are rough estimates for two. Nothing here has been applied to the plan yet.

OptionSavingTrade-offWhat else changes
Rent a car in Okinawa instead of a private driver$1,400–$1,800Leo drives, on the left. No drinking and driving at all in Japan.Leo needs an International Driving Permit. Book the car at Naha Airport for 10/20–10/31. Add parking and fuel. The Naha sushi dinner needs a taxi if he drinks.
Stay at Halekulani for all 11 Okinawa nights and skip HOSHINOYA$1,110About 30 minutes more driving each way on the Yomitan and Koza days. One less hotel move.Check Halekulani availability from 10/20. Replace the two HOSHINOYA dinners. The 10/23 hotel move goes away.
Cut two Okinawa nights (the rest days 10/27 and 10/30)$1,200–$1,600Less downtime at the end of a long trip.The trip ends 10/30. Change the return flight, the Naha to Tokyo flight and the Narita night. Later days move up and closure days need a re-check.
Benesse House Park instead of Oval on 10/13–10/14$800Lose the Oval room and its hilltop setting.Book Park as one stay, 10/13–10/18, with no room change on 10/15. Confirm after-hours museum access for Park guests.
Rent a car for the Shikoku days instead of private cars$600Narrow, winding roads in the Iya Valley, right after an early flight.Same driving permit. Pick up at Tokushima Airport on 10/8, return in Tokushima City on 10/10. Add fuel, tolls and parking.
Swap two high-end Tokyo dinners for mid-range ones, and one long lunch for a bento$600–$800Fewer marquee meals.Choose which dinners to drop. The concierge finds and vets replacements.
Skip the ROKA night and go straight to Benesse on 10/12$200–$400Lose the ryokan night and its sushi dinner.Add a Benesse night on 10/12. Dinner moves to a Benesse restaurant. The Honmura stroll folds into 10/13.
Airport bus or train from Narita on arrival instead of a private car$200Harder after a long flight, with luggage.Confirm the bus stop nearest the hotel, or take the train and a short taxi. Allow about two hours from landing.
